searchText: 🧪 **EEST release v5.3.0:** https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/v5.3.0 Includes hive related fixes on top of v5.0.0, with updated BPO parameters to align with the testnets. - Additionally new test cases for EIP-7883, EIP-7934 and critical cases for EIP-7951. excerpts.content:
🧪 **EEST release v5.3.0:** https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/v5.3.0

Includes hive related fixes on top of v5.0.0, with updated BPO parameters to align with the testnets. 
- Additionally new test cases for EIP-7883, EIP-7934 and critical cases for EIP-7951.

This will be running in todays hive CI! Thanks 😉

excerpts.author: leeederek
excerpts.content: Hey! Wanted to cross-post this to the el-testing channel. We're from Offchain Labs and wanted to flag this in case others hit similar issues. For the time being, we're going to ask Arbitrum node operators to use a different EL client for their L1 RPC connection ahead of Oct 14 - thanks!
